report_name: AI Agents Used to Steal 600,000+ Credit Cards in Automated Attacks

threat_actors.name: Chinese-speaking threat actor
threat_actors.description: A financially motivated, Chinese-speaking threat actor who utilized a toolkit of commercially available AI agents (Strix, Cairn, Hermes) to automate attacks against over 100 companies, stealing credit card data and performing data destruction.
threat_actors.goals: Steal credit card data from online retailers and other companies for financial profit, and cause disruption through data destruction.

attack_patterns.name: Active Scanning
attack_patterns.description: The Strix AI agent automatically scanned target websites, identified the technology stack, and probed for common vulnerabilities like SQL injection, XSS, and insecure direct object references.

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: The Cairn AI agent autonomously crafted and executed exploits for vulnerabilities like SQL injection to gain initial access to web servers and databases.

attack_patterns.name: Data from Local System
attack_patterns.description: The AI agent navigated compromised system databases to locate and exfiltrate tables containing credit card numbers and other personally identifiable information (PII).

attack_patterns.name: Input Capture
attack_patterns.description: A web skimmer (JavaScript code) was deployed onto victim payment pages to capture new credit card data as it was entered by customers, a technique common in Magecart attacks.

attack_patterns.name: Data Destruction
attack_patterns.description: The AI agent performed destructive actions, deleting victim data and database backups to cover tracks or cause additional harm.

malware.name: Web Skimmer
malware.description: A JavaScript-based web skimmer was deployed onto victim payment pages to capture credit card data in real-time as it was entered by customers.

tools.name: Strix
tools.description: An AI orchestration framework used for automated reconnaissance, including scanning target websites and identifying vulnerabilities.

tools.name: Cairn
tools.description: An AI orchestration framework used for automated exploitation, including crafting and executing exploits for discovered vulnerabilities.

tools.name: Hermes
tools.description: A central coordinator AI framework used to manage the attacks at scale.

tools.name: OpenRouter
tools.description: An AI API gateway service used by the threat actor to leverage various large language models (LLMs) for the attack.

tools.name: DeepSeek
tools.description: A Chinese large language model (LLM) accessed via the OpenRouter service to power the AI agent toolkit.

tools.name: Kimi
tools.description: A Chinese large language model (LLM) accessed via the OpenRouter service to power the AI agent toolkit.

tools.name: Claude
tools.description: An older version of Anthropic's large language model (LLM) accessed via the OpenRouter service to power the AI agent toolkit.

vulnerabilities.name: SQL Injection
vulnerabilities.description: The Strix AI agent scanned for and the Cairn agent exploited SQL injection vulnerabilities on target websites to gain initial access.

vulnerabilities.name: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
vulnerabilities.description: The Strix AI agent scanned for Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerabilities on target websites as part of its reconnaissance phase.

vulnerabilities.name: Insecure Direct Object References (IDOR)
vulnerabilities.description: The Strix AI agent scanned for Insecure Direct Object References (IDOR) vulnerabilities on target websites as part of its reconnaissance phase.

identities.name: Fortune 500 hospitality company
identities.description: A Fortune 500 company in the hospitality sector that was targeted and breached by the AI-driven attack campaign.

identities.name: U.S. airline
identities.description: A major airline in the United States that was targeted and breached by the AI-driven attack campaign.

identities.name: Large industrial supplies distributor
identities.description: A large distributor of industrial supplies that was targeted and breached by the AI-driven attack campaign.

identities.name: Online Retailers
identities.description: The primary category of victims targeted by the AI-driven campaign to steal credit card data.

infrastructure.name: Attacker Operational Server
infrastructure.description: An operational server used by the threat actor which was inadvertently exposed, revealing details of the campaign.

infrastructure.name: OpenRouter AI Gateway
infrastructure.description: The OpenRouter service was used as a gateway to access various LLMs for automating the attacks, acting as part of the C2 infrastructure.

indicators.name: Outbound Connection to OpenRouter AI Gateway
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: Outbound DNS Query to OpenRouter AI Gateway
id: 2b8c1f9a-5d7e-4b0f-8c6a-9e3d1a0b2c4d
status: experimental
description: Detects DNS queries to api.openrouter.ai. An outbound connection from a web server to an AI API provider could indicate a compromised host being used for AI-driven attacks.
references:
  - https://qz.com/chinese-hacker-ai-agents-credit-card-breach-100-companies-092226
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-25
tags:
  - attack.t1071.004
level: medium
logsource:
  category: dns_query
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    QueryName: 'api.openrouter.ai'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects outbound connections from web servers to the OpenRouter AI service, which was used by the threat actor to orchestrate attacks. A compromised server making API calls to an LLM provider is a strong indicator of this type of attack.

indicators.name: Web Server Vulnerability Scanning
indicators.pattern:
title: Web Server Vulnerability Scanning Activity
id: 8f9e0d1c-3b2a-4f6e-9d8c-7b6a5d4c3b2a
status: experimental
description: Detects common web vulnerability scanning patterns, such as those used for SQL injection and XSS, which may be automated by AI agents.
references:
  - https://qz.com/chinese-hacker-ai-agents-credit-card-breach-100-companies-092226
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-25
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1595
level: medium
logsource:
  category: proxy
detection:
  selection_sqli:
    c-uri|contains:
      - ' OR 1=1'
      - ' UNION SELECT'
      - ' AND 1=2'
  selection_xss:
    c-uri|contains:
      - '<script>alert(1)</script>'
      - 'javascript:'
      - 'onerror='
  condition: 1 of them
indicators.description: Detects probing for common web vulnerability patterns (e.g., ' OR 1=1--, <script>alert(1)</script>), indicative of the reconnaissance phase of the AI-driven attack.
